description: RETARGET MESSAGES (owner 06.11): a retargeting pin is a picture the person has already seen plus ONE message that removes one objection or closes the action. The picture is never generated: the text is laid over a ready picture by scripts/make_pin.py (exact letters, brand fonts, no model, no credits). Every claim on a picture must be true on the page it leads to (lesson of the Merchant Center 'Falschdarstellung' of 04.11): `facts` are checked against the website project before a pin is made. Posting the pin and the ad is done in the hub nocode/Etsy (pinterest-bulk-csv-uploader, pinterest-ads-manager, dry_run first).
